name: Berlin
description: During his glory days, Berlin and a gang assembled in Paris for one of his greatest plans ever: stealing 44 million euros' worth of jewels in one night.

videos.title: The Energy of Love
videos.overview: During his glory days, Berlin assembles a gang in Paris for an almost impossible heist for 44 million euros' worth of jewels from 34 cities in one night.

videos.title: Anchor and Lobo
videos.overview: Roi and Cameron must stop Father Toureaux as he threatens to bungle the plan. Meanwhile, love is in the air on Paris's streets — and in the Catacombs.

videos.title: Full House of Embryos
videos.overview: Everything seems to be rolling along — for a short while. While Berlin schemes to get his way with both the heist and Camille, Damián gets some bad news.

videos.title: An Aquarium on Your Back
videos.overview: The robbery is on and tensions are high as the crew starts to doubt Berlin's leadership. Keila and Bruce must make sure to cover their tracks.

videos.title: After Love
videos.overview: Cameron's resurfaced trauma bursts in at an illegal street race. The plan enters a new phase as the gang flees the police, who are hot on their heels.

videos.title: Night of the Lemons
videos.overview: Camille's suspicions heighten. Damián, Cameron and Roi have a troubling encounter, shaking the entire gang's alibis. A loose end emerges in Paris.

videos.title: The Last Virgin in the Western World
videos.overview: As Bruce helps Keila with a life-or-death situation, Sierra and Murillo join the French police to look into the theft. Berlin suffers an ultimate defeat.

videos.title: An Endangered Elephant
videos.overview: Backed into a corner, the gang maneuvers a final escape plan. Only time will tell if Berlin is ready for the ultimate bombshell.
